context_requirements: Expression of MME (neprilysin) on the cell surface
Presence of endogenous enkephalin or other MME-cleaved peptide substrates
Signaling machinery downstream of opioid receptors (e.g., OPRD1, OPRM1) if enkephalin accumulation is to affect transcription
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after 10 µM enkephalinase inhibitor treatment in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of opioid-signaling or neuropeptide-response gene sets among differentially expressed genes
Correlation between MME expression levels and transcriptional response magnitude across cell lines
